summary: Haleon plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK Market Abuse Regulation notification of a PDMR transaction, the US-equivalent disclosure for an insider dealing notice. On 17 September 2026, Senior Independent Non-Executive Director Alan Stewart acquired 242 ordinary shares at 3.378619 pence per share via dividend reinvestment on the London Stock Exchange, disclosed 18 September 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms apply; this is a routine shareholding notification, not a special situation. Arbitrageurs should disregard it, as it carries no structural or event-driven implications.
